description_en: Queries the time range within which you can specify a point in time to reset the consumer offset for a specified topic. The time range is from the point in time when the earliest stored message was published to the topic to the point in time when the most recently stored message was published to the topic
description_zh: 查询Topic可重置的时间范围，即该Topic中储存的最早的和最晚的消息的生产时间
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-consumer-time-span --group-id GID_test_group_id --topic test-mq_topic --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsConsumerTimeSpan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer group whose reset time range you want to query
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The topic to which the consumer group subscribes
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端Group ID订阅的Topic
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the consumer group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端Group ID所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

ConsumeTimeStamp.description_en: The most recent point in time when a message in the topic was consumed by the customer group
ConsumeTimeStamp.description_zh: 当前Group消费该Topic的最新时间

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the consumer group belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 需查询的消费端Group ID所对应的实例ID

MaxTimeStamp.description_en: The point in time when the most recently stored message was published to the topic
MaxTimeStamp.description_zh: 整个Topic目前最新存储的消息的生产时间

MinTimeStamp.description_en: The point in time when the earliest stored message was published to the topic
MinTimeStamp.description_zh: 整个Topic目前最早存储的消息的生产时间

Topic.description_en: The name of the topic that you want to query

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This parameter is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
